PreInvocation.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path '.agent/memory') { $json = @{ injectSteps = @( @{ ephemeralMessage = 'MEMORIA: Consulte .agent/memory/ antes de agir. Verifique anti-patterns e decisoes anteriores. Nao assuma — leia os arquivos.' } ) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 -Compress; Write-Output $json } else { Write-Output '{\"injectSteps\":[]}' }"

Stop.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$input_data = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $reason = $input_data.terminationReason; if ($reason -eq 'model_stop') { Write-Output '{\"decision\":\"allow\"}' } else { Write-Output '{\"decision\":\"allow\"}' }"
